# Core Summary
Two armored ancient knights engage in a rain-soaked duel, culminating in a hyper-detailed slow-motion blade collision. 2-shot progression. Shot 1 establishes the stormy arena and combatants raising weapons in tension. Shot 2 executes an extreme close-up of the steel impact, highlighting elastic blade deformation, physics-accurate spark trajectories, and shattering raindrops with cold metallic reflections.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03]
Outdoor muddy battlefield under a heavy, overcast grey sky. Torrential rain falls vertically, creating a misty atmosphere. The ground is dark wet earth. Lighting is dim and diffuse, casting soft shadows on the wet terrain.
Audio Description: Heavy rain ambience, distant thunder rumble, wind howling softly.

[shot2][00:03-00:10]
Extreme macro environment focusing solely on the intersection of steel blades against a dark, blurred background. Lighting shifts to high-contrast chiaroscuro to emphasize metallic reflections and spark brightness. Volumetric rain mist hangs in the air around the impact zone.
Audio Description: Rain sound muffles slightly, deep resonant metal clash sustains, high-pitched spark crackle synchronizes with visual impact.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>
- Gender: male
- Race/Ethnicity: European/North American
- Age: middle-aged
- Appearance features: Wearing weathered ancient steel plate armor with riveted details, dark grey metal surface with scratches. Helmet covers face, only eye slit visible. Holds a long steel broadsword.
- Vocal Characteristics: Heavy breathing audible, no speech.

<ID_B>
- Gender: male
- Race/Ethnicity: European/North American
- Age: middle-aged
- Appearance features: Wearing matching ancient steel plate armor, slightly more dented than <ID_A>. Helmet is closed steel pot helm. Grips a steel longsword with leather-wrapped hilt.
- Vocal Characteristics: Grunt of exertion, no speech.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03]
Medium Shot. <ID_A> stands on the left side of the frame facing right, <ID_B> stands on the right side facing left, separated by three meters. Both knights simultaneously raise their steel swords overhead, muscles tensing under armor. Rain streams off their shoulder plates. The camera slowly pushes in (Dolly In) towards the center gap between them. Water droplets ripple on the muddy ground as they shift weight.

[shot2][00:03-00:10]
Extreme Close-Up Slow Motion. The two swords descend and collide violently in the center of the frame. Upon contact, the steel blades visibly bend elastically under the force, curving outward before snapping back. Bright orange-yellow sparks erupt precisely from the impact point, trajectories flying tangentially outward following the collision angle. Raindrops hitting the vibrating blades shatter into microscopic mist instantly. Cold blue-grey metallic reflections slide along the blade edges as they vibrate. Sparks synchronize perfectly with the millisecond of contact, no latency. The camera holds static macro focus on the intersection point, capturing the friction and heat distortion in the air.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style is hyper-realistic cinematic with high dynamic range. Color palette dominated by cold steel blues, greys, and muddy browns, sharply contrasted by warm orange-yellow spark emissions. Lighting emphasizes specular highlights on wet metal and volumetric rain shafts. Textures are gritty and tactile, emphasizing scratches on armor and water surface tension. Image quality is crisp with deep depth of field in the close-up to isolate the spark physics.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Tense, dramatic, and visceral. The atmosphere is heavy with the weight of combat and the brutality of the storm. The slow motion emphasizes the power and physics of the strike, creating a sense of suspended time and imminent danger.
